reports.title: Building and Housing Census
reports.description: EVAS register no. 31211 (Gebäude- und Wohnungszählung). A full survey of Germany's housing stock, conducted alongside the population census -- most recently 2022 and 2011. The GNI inventory names it directly and repeatedly as the primary data source for housing services (imputed and actual rent) in the production/expenditure accounts: 'With the results of the 2022 building and housing census (EVAS 31211), data on rental income per square metre and the corresponding floor area are available for the first time from a full survey', and its results are the 'current benchmark' for the housing-services calculation between census years.
reports.cadence_note: GNI inventory: conducted 2011 and 2022, an 11-year interval -- entered as a nominal rate (1/11) rather than guessed, per the corpus's own 'a number can say once a generation' convention for the decennial US census (0.1) and SNA 2008 (0.05). Not independently cross-checked against a stated future schedule on a separate Destatis page this round.

reports.title: Microcensus Additional Survey on the Housing Situation of Households
reports.description: EVAS register no. 12212 -- the microcensus's housing supplementary programme, distinct from the core annual microcensus (EVAS 12211, minted in de-national-core-2026-09-07.json). The GNI inventory names it by its full official title directly: 'Information on service charges (excluding energy) is available from the Microcensus Additional Survey on the Housing Situation of Households (EVAS 12212). The most recent surveys were conducted in 2018 and 2022.' Also used, per the same document, to extrapolate housing floor-area data between building-census years.
reports.cadence_note: GNI inventory: 'The most recent surveys were conducted in 2018 and 2022' -- a 4-year interval, matching the microcensus's own broader supplementary-survey rotation. Not independently cross-checked against a stated future schedule this round.

reports.title: Tax Revenue Statistics
reports.description: EVAS register no. 71211 (Steuerhaushalt / Kassenmäßige Steuereinnahmen). Destatis's own EN page titles this 'Tax revenue' and reports cash tax revenue by type of tax. The GNI inventory's Chapter 10 summary table glosses the same EVAS number 'Tax revenue statistics'; its body text cites the identical EVAS number twice as 'public finance statistics' (land transfer tax revenue for the housing-services and real-estate-services calculations) and once as 'fiscal statistics' (the second-home tax added to housing services) -- three English glosses for one release inside the same document, recorded here as title_aliases sourced from that document rather than picked for the node.
reports.cadence_note: Destatis publishes both annual (Fachserie 14 Reihe 4) and quarterly ('Statistischer Bericht Steuerhaushalt') releases; not independently cross-checked against a stated periodicity document this round -- entered as quarterly (4) since that is the more frequent, live-confirmed release cadence (destatis.de lists quarterly 'Statistischer Bericht Steuerhaushalt' reports through 2024).
